description: League scoring values. TOT = sum of (stat x points) over the categories below.

notes.TOT: Verified against all 371 players carrying stats in all_players_data.json.
notes.AVG_skaters: AVG = TOT / GP. Verified for all 326 skaters with games played.
notes.AVG_goalies: AVG is TOT divided by games played, which is not a column in this dataset (GS is starts, not appearances). Only 11 of 49 goalies match TOT / GS.
notes.D_PTS: Not an ESPN league setting and not a column in the data. It is an extra per-point bonus applied only to players with POS = D, worth D_PTS for every goal and assist they record. Default 0, so it changes nothing until you raise it.
